thread:
Maya (Finance): Morning — accounting spotted ~75 tiny credit memos created overnight. They reference Stripe invoices from 06-14. Can billing poke?

billing-bot: nightly-usage-agg finished: job_id=nj-20240614-02, processed=78,004 accounts, warnings=5, errors=0

Lee (Accounting): Yup, NetSuite shows duplicated credit memos for the same invoice ids. I've flagged them and put a hold on posting for now.

Ravi (Billing): Looking into the reconciler logs. There's a backfill job `bf-811` that ran last night. It emitted invoice_adjust events with small negative amounts. The reconciler turned those into invoice_update events.

Tess (Engineering): Checking connector logs — I see a cluster of retries to NetSuite between 02:55-03:05 UTC. Some pushes returned 504 and the connector retried without preserving the original idempotency key. That would create duplicate memos.

Omar (SRE): NetSuite upstream had a transient outage window at 02:57 (we got 504s). Gateway retried 10s, 30s, 90s. Counted 22 retries during that window.

Maya (Finance): So combination of backfill + retry without idempotency. Can we pause replays and add a fix?

Ravi (Billing): I'm pausing any webhook replays and the outbound NetSuite queue for invoices touched by bf-811.

billing-bot: outbound-queue paused: target=netSuite, scope=backfill:bf-811 by ravi at 1718401320

Tess (Engineering): Proposed fix: include `X-NS-Idempotency: ns:{event_uuid}` header on every push and ensure retry propagation keeps that header. Also ignore 'negative delta' events when `source=backfill` unless `confirm=true`. I'll open a small patch.

Lee (Accounting): For remediation, can we run a dedupe-recon that lists pairs of memos created within 10 minutes with same invoice id? CSV should include customer tier and amount.

Omar (SRE): I'll run the recon-cli in dry-run: `recon-cli dedupe --window 2024-06-14T02:30..2024-06-14T03:30 --threshold 10m` and upload CSV to s3.

Tess (Engineering): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/netSuite-connector/pull/134 — adds idempotency header + retry propagation. Small unit test added. Will deploy to staging.

Ravi (Billing): Staging run shows retries with same idempotency header get 200 with no duplicates. Recon dry-run collapsed 68 duplicates into 12 merge candidates.

Lee (Accounting): I reviewed the staging CSV. 3 enterprise customers affected — will notify account teams before any action. For non-enterprise, approve automated void+reissue.

Maya (Finance): Good. Timeline?

Omar (SRE): Deploy to prod in 10m behind a throttle (5r/s) and circuit-breaker: if 429/504 > 15/min pause outbound.

billing-bot: prod-deploy started: deploy_id=deploy-1718401480, component=netSuite-connector

Tess (Engineering): Prod deploy succeeded at 1718401505. Retrying behavior looks fixed on tested payloads.

Omar (SRE): Recon job on prod finished. CSV: s3://redwood-billing/recon/dedupe-1718401560.csv. Ravi, please hand off to Lee for approval and runbook note.

Ravi (Billing): CSV shared, Lee confirmed non-enterprise void+reissue approved. Pausing enterprise replays until account teams acknowledge.

Lee (Accounting): Notified account teams for 3 enterprise customers. Will schedule manual merges after their OK.

Maya (Finance): Thanks team. Action items: Tess to merge PR and update runbook; Omar to keep circuit-breaker; Ravi to coordinate NetSuite resume; Lee to run approved changes. I'll close once enterprise merges are done.
